subject: Igbo
sourceFile: Copy of Igbo BECE Syllabus - syllabusNG.txt
examFormat: Part of the 9-year Basic Education Curriculum for Igbo, the syllabus aims at fluent speaking, reading and writing of Igbo as a mother tongue/immediate environment language (L1) or as a second language (L2), and assesses reading, writing and comprehension, correct sentence construction, literary appreciation, translation from English to Igbo, and understanding of Igbo customs, social values, norms, institutions and traditions. L1 has two papers of 60 multiple-choice questions each (120 in all): Paper 1 covers comprehension (10), composition (5), grammar (25), sound system (10), orthography (5) and translation (5); Paper 2 covers oral literature (15), prose (5), drama (5), poetry (5) and culture and tradition (20). L2 is one 1-hour paper of 60 multiple-choice questions in sections A-D: written comprehension (10), dialogue (10), numbers, greetings, alphabets, translation, grammar and culture (25), and pictures of time, the human body, animals, crops, utensils and school-related items (15).
excluded: syllabus.ng 'About us', 'About BECE', eligibility, grading, registration and FAQ chapters. The L1 and L2 syllabuses are combined in this one file; L2 topic names are suffixed '(L2)'. The extraction dropped Igbo diacritics (dotted vowels, tone marks) and garbled many words, so Igbo is written in plain orthography with clear OCR errors corrected (e.g. 'Myinudaume' → 'Myiriudaume', 'Akpaalaokuu' → 'Akpaalaokwu'). Several items were cut off at line ends and were completed only where the rest is obvious; unclear words were kept close to the source (e.g. 'Mburo/Mburu', 'Omemnobi', 'Aka md Ocha', 'Oruuru'). The prose title 'CEIUKWU NONSO' is read as 'Chukwu Nonso' (doubtful). The poetry set book is printed both as 'Zeruwa' by Ikechukwu Ihejirika and 'Zereuwa nke Okechukwu Ihejirika'; 'Zeruwa' / Ikechukwu Ihejirika is used. Topic XVII 'Orubere na oru umuaka' is given as 'Oke na oru umuaka' and XIII 'Oniru oya na-azu ahia' as 'Oruuru onye na-azu ahia', from their content items.
